title: Depth map
description: Gets the depth map of a photo: what is near and what is far, in colour, in grey and in 3D. Everything is processed in your browser.
intro: Gets the depth map of a photo: what is near and what is far. See it in colour and in 3D, and download it as PNG.
drop: Drop an image here, paste it, or click to choose one
action.downloadAndRun: Download the model ({size}) and make the depth map
catalog.name: Depth map
catalog.line: Works out what is near and what is far in a photo, with a colour map, a 3D view and PNG downloads.
preview.caption: {name} · {width} × {height} px
result.scaled: The photo is {sourceWidth} × {sourceHeight} px; it was scaled down to {width} × {height} px for the depth map.
result.elongated: The photo is very elongated: the model sees it with very few pixels one way, and the map says little.
map.title: Depth map
map.alt: Colour depth map of {name}: lighter tones are nearer
map.legend: The lighter, the nearer. This is relative depth: it orders what is near and far, it does not measure distances.
view.title: 3D view
view.label: 3D view of {name}. Drag it or use the arrow keys to turn it.
view.hint: Drag it to turn it, or use the arrow keys. The Home key goes back to the first view.
file.name: image
